claude_proposed_widenings.name: creature_compulsion (new payload family)
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The spell's core pattern is: save gate on a target creature → on fail, the creature is compelled to autonomously perform a multi-step task (travel to location + deliver message) for the spell's duration. No existing SpellMechanics family models this shape. 'activation' resolves instantly with damage/none; 'ongoing_effect' applies a roll/damage rider to an attachment scope; 'anchored_trigger' plants a trigger on a location, not on a creature; 'triggered_reaction' is caster-reaction-shaped. A new payload family is needed.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: A Tiny Beast of your choice that you can see within range must succeed on a Charisma saving throw, or it attempts to deliver a message for you...The Beast travels for the duration toward the specified location, covering about 25 miles per 24 hours

claude_proposed_widenings.name: command_creature (Effect union variant)
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The Effect union is {damage | none}. Compelling an existing wild creature to perform an autonomous task cannot be represented by either. v4 has 'command_companion' but that targets an already-bound companion; this spell compels an unbound wild beast chosen at cast time. A new Effect variant is needed, distinct from command_companion.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: it attempts to deliver a message for you...The Beast travels for the duration toward the specified location

claude_proposed_widenings.name: Duration slot-scaling variant
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: Duration.timed only holds a fixed DurationValue. Animal Messenger's duration scales with slot level: 24 hours base, +48 hours per slot above 2. There is no slot-scaled Duration shape in the surface types.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: The spell's duration increases by 48 hours for each spell slot level above 2.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: save_gate CR-conditional auto-succeed
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: Creatures with CR > 0 automatically succeed on the saving throw; the save only matters for CR 0 beasts. This conditional bypass on a save gate has no surface representation. It is not the same as 'save DC that auto-fails or auto-succeeds' — here the condition is a property of the target (its CR), not the roll.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: if the target's Challenge Rating isn't 0, it automatically succeeds
